problems.prompt: The mass of the earth is 6 × 10^24 kg and that of the moon is 7.4 × 10^22 kg. If the distance between the earth and the moon is 3.84 × 10^5 km, calculate the force exerted by the earth on the moon. (Take G = 6.7 × 10^-11 N m^2 kg^-2)
problems.attempt_hint: Distance km me hai, use hamesha meters mein convert karo 1000 se multiply karke, uske baad F = G M m / d^2 lagao.

solution_steps.narration: Pehle distance ko standard unit yani meter mein convert karna zaruri hai.
Universal law of gravitation ka formula apply karenge aur saari values dalenge.
Numbers aur powers of 10 ko alag-alag solve karenge. (6.7 × 6 × 7.4) aur 10^(-11+24+22).
Division karke final answer Newtons mein aayega.

problems.prompt: A stone is dropped from the edge of a roof. It passes a window 2 metres below the roof in 0.5 s. How far is the window from the ground if the stone hits the ground 3 seconds after being dropped? (Take g = 9.8 m/s^2)
problems.attempt_hint: Equation of motion s = ut + 1/2 gt^2 use karke total building ki height nikalo.

solution_steps.narration: Kyunki stone 'dropped' hai, initial velocity zero hogi. Hame total time 3s diya hai, to pehle total height (H) nikalte hain.
Total height calculate karte hain.

Window top se 2m neeche thi? Nahi, question ka first part sirf confuse karne ke liye tha. Agar window ko ground se doori chahiye aur window roof se 2m neeche nahi hai balki drop window pe se pass hui hai. Wait, question mein direct 'how far is the window from ground' pucha hai, matlab total height = 44.1m. Window 2m below roof hai, toh ground se height = H - 2.
Final subtraction.

problems.prompt: An object is thrown vertically upwards and rises to a height of 10 m. Calculate the velocity with which the object was thrown upwards and the time taken by the object to reach the highest point. (Take g = 9.8 m/s^2)
problems.attempt_hint: Jab time nahi diya ho, to initial velocity u nikalne ke liye v^2 - u^2 = 2gh use karein.

solution_steps.narration: Upar jaate huye g negative hota hai aur top par final velocity zero hoti hai.
Solve karke u nikalenge.
Ab time nikalne ke liye first equation v = u + gt lagayenge.
Time ke liye simplify karenge.

problems.answer: Initial velocity is 14 m/s, Time taken is 1.43 s.

problems.prompt: Mass of an object is 10 kg. What is its weight on the earth? What will be its weight on the moon? (Take g on earth = 9.8 m/s^2)
problems.attempt_hint: Earth ka weight nikalne ke liye mg, aur moon ka nikalne ke liye answer ko 6 se divide karo.

solution_steps.narration: Earth par weight simple W = mg hota hai.
Moon ki gravity Earth ka 1/6th hoti hai.
Division solve karenge.

problems.answer: 98 N on Earth, 16.33 N on Moon

problems.prompt: A solid block of dimensions 50 cm x 20 cm x 10 cm and mass 10 kg is placed on a table. Find the maximum and minimum pressure it can exert on the table. (Take g = 10 m/s^2)
problems.attempt_hint: Max pressure ke liye minimum area lo, aur min pressure ke liye maximum area lo.

solution_steps.narration: Pehle block ka total thrust yani weight nikalenge.
Minimum pressure tab hoga jab area maximum hoga. Maximum area sabse badi sides (50cm, 20cm) se banega.
Min pressure nikalte hain.
Maximum pressure tab hoga jab area minimum (10cm, 20cm) ho.
Max pressure nikalte hain.

problems.answer: Maximum Pressure is 5000 Pa, Minimum Pressure is 1000 Pa.

problems.prompt: The volume of a solid of mass 500 g is 350 cm^3. Will the solid float or sink in water? What will be the mass of water displaced by this solid? (Density of water = 1 g/cm^3)
problems.attempt_hint: Density nikal ke paani ki density (1) se compare karo. Agar doobega toh apna poora volume displace karega.

solution_steps.narration: Pehle solid ki density nikalte hain Mass/Volume formula se.
Kyunki object ki density paani (1 g/cm^3) se zyada hai, object doob (sink) jayega.
Agar object poora doobta hai to wo apne khud ke volume ke barabar paani hatayega.
Paani ka mass nikalne ke liye Volume ko water ki density se multiply karenge.

problems.answer: It will sink. Mass of displaced water is 350 g.
